label: Preview tabs on hover *Zen's own preview of a tab's title and site, shown while you point at the tab. Zen ships with it off; this turns it on, and turning Peekflow off puts your old setting back.*
Where it opens *Relative to the tab you point at. If there is no room on that side, it moves to fit on screen.*
Gap from the tab *In pixels. Applies to every place but Zen's default.*
Picture of the page *Loaded tabs show a live picture of the page.*

Last view of unloaded tabs *An unloaded tab shows the page as you last left it, and how long ago that was. Pictures stay in memory for this session only and are never saved to disk; a private window's are gone when it closes. Needs Picture of the page.*
